rows.note: Use 病 as the all-purpose noun for a physical disease or illness in people, animals, or plants.

example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 beng6 hou2 ji6 cyun4 jim5

rows.note: Use 疾病 instead of 病 mainly in formal or written contexts when referring to a disease as a medical condition.

example.english: Preventing disease is more important than treating disease.
example.traditional: 預防疾病比治療疾病重要。
example.jyutping: jyu6 fong4 zat6 beng6 bei2 zi6 liu4 zat6 beng6 zung6 jiu3
